admission.justification: Compatibility must omit genuinely absent optional display blocks without weakening the current producer contract or using an impossible consumer-authored fixture.

applicability: A current task reader receiving an older task-document projection without the newly added display fields.
conditions: An absent whole review state omits its block/count without error.
Recorded genuine producer envelopes exercise compatibility, not invented wire casts.
exclusions: Making current producer review counts optional.
Declaring negative recorded age values a permanent normative guarantee.

evidence: dashboard/src/panels/detail-panel/older-server.test.tsx: five tests; notes/reports/worker/7b2c4e19-5d63-4a8f-b1e0-127000000a01/evidence-f7/checks/counter-run-review-block-without-its-guard.log; instrument notes/reports/worker/7b2c4e19-5d63-4a8f-b1e0-127000000a01/evidence-f7/instruments/record_payload.py (SHA-256 140cfb4a07776ede49b6251139d539e9ceffb1d415592a6671ea34cba261b3e8); notes/reports/worker/7b2c4e19-5d63-4a8f-b1e0-127000000a01/role-launch/260928-MIK-L127-worker-7b2c4e19-5d63-4a8f-b1e0-127000000a01-F7.md; the focused set of the reports: 331 passed in 40 files

statement: A task document from a server of an older build, which lacks the fields this task added, is drawn without the blocks those fields feed and without an error: a page of this build reads what the task-document projection of commit 3c2285d1 sends and draws no Review block, no count of findings, no status note and no header notes.
